title: The Supreme Court's Landmark Ruling Explained

scenes.text: A new ruling means police need warrants for phone location data!
This pivotal decision impacts how police access personal phone information.
Privacy advocates celebrate this as a win for citizens' rights.
Is our data truly safe now? The battle for privacy continues.
